name: Crystal Quest: Arcane Tower
review:
Crystal Quest: Arcane Tower is a 6-reel, 4,096-ways fantasy slot with avalanches, infinite multipliers and a linked reels feature.

Thunderkick rates it High volatility, with a 15,000x cap and a 96.17% RTP. Part of the Crystal Quest trilogy.

The linked reels feature is what sets this one apart from its two siblings: matching reels make big ways wins much more likely, and every avalanche pushes the uncapped multiplier further.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
